metrics.formula: base_manual_attempts_per_second * manual_performance if founder_focus and online_units > 0 else 0
online_units * fn['unit_load'] * (1 + 0.15 * automate_rank) + p['coordination_pair_load'] * online_units * max(0, online_units - 1)
online_units * p['coordination_capacity_per_ops_unit'] * (1 + 0.25 * craft_rank) if function_id == 'operations' else 0
clamp(fn['base_error'] + p['strain_error_coefficient'] * excess_strain ** 2 + p['rot_error_coefficient'] * context_rot ** 2, 0, p['max_error_probability'])

ratio(autonomous_attempts_per_second, manual_attempts_per_second + autonomous_attempts_per_second) if manual_attempts_per_second + autonomous_attempts_per_second > 0 else 0

executed_auto_attempts_per_second * (p['rot_per_auto_attempt_base'] + p['rot_per_auto_attempt_rank'] * automate_rank) * (1 + 0.5 * excess_strain) + configuration_changes * p['rot_per_configuration_change'] / dt
clamp(0.08 + 0.03 * automate_rank + 0.25 * context_rot + 0.08 * excess_strain - 0.015 * craft_rank - 0.10 * verification_share, 0, 0.75)
expected_accepted_output_per_second if function_id == 'operations' and fn['mode'] == 'maintain' else 0
p['upgrade_base_cents'] * p['upgrade_cost_ratio'] ** selected_axis_rank if selected_axis_rank < 4 else None

metrics.formula: segment['needs'][0] * capability_speed + segment['needs'][1] * capability_collaboration + segment['needs'][2] * capability_control
clamp(0.85 * (0.3 + 0.7 * fit) / (1 + price_to_wtp ** 4), 0, 0.95) if price_to_wtp <= p['maximum_accepted_price_to_wtp'] else 0
count * addon_count_per_customer * addon_price_cents if active else 0
count * segment['service_cents_month'] * (1 + p['addon_service_cost_fraction'] * addon_count_per_customer) if active else 0

p['health_fit_gain'] * (fit - p['health_fit_neutral']) - p['health_defect_loss'] * defect_exposure - p['health_overpricing_loss'] * overpricing + p['health_care_gain'] * care_coverage - p['health_incident_loss'] * incident_exposure

count * (p['addon_slots_per_customer'] - addon_count_per_customer) if score_eligible and addon_price_cents >= 1 and age_ticks >= p['expansion_maturity_months'] * p['ticks_per_month'] and health >= p['expansion_min_health'] else 0
clamp(0.1 + 0.7 * fit + 0.002 * (health - 50) - 0.35 * addon_price_cents / max(1, effective_wtp_cents), 0.01, 0.95) if expansion_eligible_slots > 0 else 0

window_open_arr_cents + window_new_arr_cents + window_expansion_arr_cents - window_contraction_arr_cents - window_churn_arr_cents - window_eligibility_loss_arr_cents + window_eligibility_restore_arr_cents
window_new_arr_cents + window_expansion_arr_cents - window_contraction_arr_cents - window_churn_arr_cents - window_eligibility_loss_arr_cents + window_eligibility_restore_arr_cents
max(0, window_cogs_cents + window_opex_cents + window_interest_cents - window_revenue_cents) / window_months

clamp(1 / (1 + p['burn_weight'] * ongoing_burn_ratio + p['shortfall_weight'] * forecast_shortfall_fraction), p['capital_factor_floor'], 1)

max(0, p['debt_capacity_mrr_multiple'] * eligible_mrr_cents - total_debt_cents) if eligible_mrr_cents >= p['debt_min_mrr_cents'] else 0
ceildiv(baseline_arr_cents * (10000 + growth_target_bps), 10000) if baseline_arr_cents >= p['arr_floor_cents'] else absolute_target_arr_cents
active and now_tick >= deadline_tick and current_arr_cents < required_arr_cents
max(0, deadline_tick - now_tick) if active else None

due failure is settled before new milestone awards

precision.currency_ledgers: integer cents; do not round a rendered display back into state
precision.service_accrual: integer numerator += monthly_mrr_cents * elapsed_ticks; divide by ticks_per_month with remainder carried
precision.interest_accrual: integer numerator += principal_cents * apr_bps each complete financial month; divide by 120000 with remainder carried
precision.work_credit: fractional work retained; spend only floor(credit) completed attempts; never treat expected output as guaranteed realized output
precision.ratio_comparison: the Python reference is authoritative for candidate verification; a JS port must pass fixtures; not claimed cross-language bit-identical
precision.rounding: score floor; liabilities requiring fractional-cent accrual carry remainder; price floor; VC requirement integer ceiling
